digest.component_or_area: epic completion verifier and close gate
propositions: Agents file bugs outside epic hierarchy during execution, marking them out-of-scope when they are actual defects in the epic's deliverable; the direct-children close gate cannot see these orphaned bugs.

A three-stage deterministic-and-LLM gate is needed: (1) DET floor blocks on any open/in_progress bug with caused_by edge to the epic or descendant, (2) DET candidate filter identifies bugs created after epic's first in_progress transition or linked to the epic subtree, (3) haiku relevance screen evaluates candidates for deliverable defect vs pre-existing with disposition adjudication.

The verifier must adjudicate by store-grounded disposition signals: supersedes/duplicates link (either direction) or reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose in the bug record, never by close_class, and must block only undispositioned defects in deliverable.

Screen output must ride the overlap_verdict idiom (registered schema + normalizing validator in contracts.py), forward compact candidates (title+citation+id, max 8) inside precheck-assembled fenced context, and record full tally in completion sidecar with unevaluated-overflow count when ceiling (32 candidates) is reached.

Screen must use model-class config and shared cache settings (TRIVIAL_CLASS via resolve_model_string), implement warm-then-parallel fan-out pattern, and degrade open on model failure; commit-relation criterion is explicitly rejected and not implemented.

Regression fixtures must verify: must-block cases (30a2, 5b09) on caused_by floor or via verifier disposition rule, must-pass cases (30d3, e6a0, c8ed) via reasoned prose or links, and not-flagged cases (5e94, 22f5) outside timing window or already closed.
